Wix: add AI payment — APIbase apibase@prod:~$ cat /srv/apibase/integrator/platforms/wix | render APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Menu APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Integrator Agent guide Buyers Docs Shops Wix: add AI payment For a Wix site. Nothing to install, no plugin and no script: you paste a link. First connect your shop at /integrator/connect (or with your agent: /integrator/agent-guide) and note your <slug> . Steps In the editor add a button next to the product. Set the button link to a web address and paste link A; set the label to the link text. For link C, add a text element with the shop link on the home page. Publish the site. The links A, button at a product: https://apibase.pro/m/<slug>/p/<sku> B, button at checkout: https://apibase.pro/m/<slug>/cart?items=<sku>:1 C, "AI purchase" block on the home page: https://apibase.pro/m/<slug> Use the link text "Buy with your AI agent". Ready-made markup for each: /integrator#options. Menu names change between versions of the builder; the link itself does not. Check the result at /integrator/check/<slug> .
